WITH site_totals AS (
  SELECT zoneref AS site_code, SUM(traitcount) AS feature_count
  FROM scanfeatures
  WHERE traitcount IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY zoneref
), shares AS (
  SELECT site_code, feature_count,
         feature_count::numeric / SUM(feature_count) OVER () AS share
  FROM site_totals
), average_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares
)
SELECT s.site_code,
       s.feature_count,
       s.share,
       s.share - a.avg_share AS margin_above_average
FROM shares s
CROSS JOIN average_share a
WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
ORDER BY margin_above_average DESC
LIMIT 10;
